Twenty individuals were ultimately convicted and executed.

This has changed dramatically in recent years; restaurant customers now expect a straw to accompany every drink. contents.text: Traditional pesticides and fertilizers are the clear winners in driving away insects and enriching the soil for healthy crops. However, they often contain harsh chemicals that are dangerous for animals and the environment. As a result, many farmers have started using "green fertilizers," which reduce the impact on the environment and are much safer for everyone's health, including the farmers themselves. These safe alternatives include natural ingredients like crushed shells or even dried blood. Over time, these fertilizers can also improve the quality of the soil, while chemical fertilizers can cause lasting damage to the earth. How do you know which fertilizers are green? Easy! Just look for the labels "organic" or "natural" at the store.

Meanwhile, the leaves that fall from the squash plants keep the soil from drying out and, being prickly, deter hungry critters. Finally, the beans absorb nitrogen from the air and release it into the soil, enriching the growing environment.

If a noun ends in consonant-y, then drop the y and add -ies to make it plural.
If a noun ends in -f or -fe and the /f/ sound changes to /v/ when it's plural, drop the -f or -fe and add -ves to make it plural.
If a noun ends in -f or -fe and the plural form keeps the /f/ sound, just add -s to make it plural.
If a noun ends in -o, usually add -s to make it plural. However, add -es for the following exceptions: tomato, potato, hero, echo, tornado, volcano, and mango.
To form the plural of a compound noun, like sister-in-law, only pluralize the base word of the noun. The base word in sister-in-law is sister, so the plural form is sisters-in-law.
